detailed_description: The Candlestick Chart Generator builds an interactive chart from manual OHLC rows in the browser. Start with the sample data or add your own date, open, close, low, and high values one row at a time. You can set a chart title, choose up and down candle colors, toggle MA5, MA10, and MA20 moving-average lines, zoom through the chart with the built-in ECharts slider, and export the current chart as PNG or SVG. It does not connect to outside sources or make trading recommendations; it is not investment advice.
usage_steps: Edit the chart title and choose the up and down candle colors.
Use the existing OHLC rows or click Add Data to insert another date.
Enter open, close, low, and high values for each row.
Toggle MA5, MA10, or MA20 moving-average lines as needed.
Review the chart preview and use the zoom slider for denser manual rows.
Download the current chart as PNG or SVG.
usage_examples: Create a small sample price chart for a finance lesson.
Compare a few manually entered OHLC rows before adding the image to a report.
Export a simple candlestick SVG for documentation or a presentation.
Use MA5 and MA10 overlays to illustrate moving-average basics.

faqs.question: Can I import a file?
faqs.answer: No. This version uses an on-page row editor and a sample-data button.

faqs.question: Does it connect to price services?
faqs.answer: No. Enter the OHLC values yourself or load the sample data.

faqs.question: Which moving averages are available?
faqs.answer: You can toggle MA5, MA10, and MA20 lines calculated from the close values.

faqs.question: Can I export the chart?
faqs.answer: Yes. The current ECharts preview can be downloaded as PNG or SVG.

faqs.question: Does it identify chart formations?
faqs.answer: No. It only visualizes the OHLC data you enter and is not investment advice.
